new_public_api: pub struct CounterexampleBundleRecord { pub summary: CounterexampleBundleSummary, pub workspace_id: String, pub property_kind: HypothesisKind, pub minimised: MinimisedPayload, pub created_at_ms: u64, pub events: Vec<TraceEvent> }
pub struct CounterexampleBundleSummary { pub bundle_id: String, pub workspace_id: String, pub property_kind: HypothesisKind, pub rounds_used: u32, pub has_full_bundle: bool, pub created_at_ms: u64 }
pub enum MinimisedPayload { Constant(PropertyValue), Predicate(ExistencePredicateWire), CallerCallee { caller: String, callee: String, max_depth: Option<usize> } }
pub struct ExistencePredicateWire { /* mirror of chronos_services::ExistencePredicate */ }
pub struct CounterexampleBundleFilter { pub workspace_id: Option<String>, pub property_kind: Option<HypothesisKind>, pub since_ms: Option<u64>, pub until_ms: Option<u64>, pub limit: u32 }
pub struct MinimisedPayloadRecord { pub kind: MinimisedKind, pub constant: Option<PropertyValue>, pub predicate: Option<ExistencePredicateWire>, pub caller_callee: Option<CallerCalleeRecord> }

impl SessionStore { pub fn save_counterexample_bundle(&self, record) -> Result<(), redb::Error>; pub fn load_counterexample_bundle(&self, id) -> Result<Option<CounterexampleBundleRecord>, redb::Error>; pub fn list_counterexample_bundles(&self, filter) -> Result<Vec<CounterexampleBundleSummary>, redb::Error> }

services_module_extensions.disclosure_r2: no spawn_blocking wrap; runner.run() does not cross an await point inside shrink(). M8-05 wraps if needed.

output_module_extensions.disclosure_b3: Vec<TraceEvent> NOT on wire. Agents that need trace re-fetch via future counterexample_bundle_events tool.

sandbox_smoke.helper: async fn setup_with_probe(fixture: &str) -> Option<(McpTestClient, String)> — runs probe_start + probe_stop so the engines map has the session_id at shrink time.

decisions_inherited_from_scoping.B1_string_keyed_redb_table: Justification: shape is minimal (one table, one blob value), no second events table until m8-04. Cost: one rewrite per save().
decisions_inherited_from_scoping.B2_saved_variant_with_full_bundle_true: Single-variant truth source for bundle persistence. Got variant reserved for read paths.
decisions_inherited_from_scoping.B3_no_vec_trace_event_on_wire: Agents re-fetch via future counterexample_bundle_events tool. Keeps shrink/get responses small.
decisions_inherited_from_scoping.B4_externally_tagged_property_value_on_w: Matches existing chronos-domain serde derive. Inline JSON is {Number: 42.0} not {type:number,value:42.0}.
decisions_inherited_from_scoping.B5_saved_serialises_to_saved_summary_sto: Stopgap envelope; m8-04 close-time rework folds Saved into same CounterexampleBundleDto as Shrunk.

decisions_added_in_execute.saved_variant_derive_debug: Test ergonomics. No public API impact.
decisions_added_in_execute.hypothesis_input_wire_dto_10_option_fiel: 10 Option<T> fields, one per source field. Decode is clone-into-HypothesisInput. PropertyValue / ExistencePredicate serialise via existing impls.
decisions_added_in_execute.bundle_storage_uses_wire_mirror_existenc: R5. chronos-store cannot depend on chronos-services. ExistencePredicateWire is a wire-shape duplicate; conversion is one line in chronos-services at the boundary.
decisions_added_in_execute.table_does_not_exist_collapses_to_ok_non: Read-only open_table on a never-written table should not surface IO error. Matches existing storage.rs pattern.
decisions_added_in_execute.sandbox_setup_helper_runs_probe_stop: B7. The MCP server only inserts session_id into engines map at probe_stop. Without stop the dispatcher returns SessionNotFound. Documented in setup_with_probe comment.
decisions_added_in_execute.just_value_strategy_in_m8_03: R1. m8-03 binds the real proptest::test_runner API but the sampler is Just(value). M8-05 swaps in a real shrinker without a service-signature change.
decisions_added_in_execute.no_spawn_blocking_in_m8_03: R2. runner.run() does not cross an await point inside shrink(). M8-05 wraps if needed.

experimental_disclosures.title: HypothesisInput → proptest::Strategy adapter is non-trivial (per M8 doc C0)
experimental_disclosures.m8_03_status: RESOLVED for shape — real Strategy impls via build_strategy_for + Just(target.clone()). rounds_used == 1 always.
experimental_disclosures.remaining_work: M8-05 swaps in a real shrinker (e.g. proptest::strategy::Map over target.constant) without a service-signature change.

experimental_disclosures.title: proptest::TestRunner::run is synchronous-wrapper, not async
experimental_disclosures.m8_03_status: DOCUMENTED. Outer shrink() is async; inner runner.run does not cross await point inside shrink(). No spawn_blocking wrap in m8-03.
experimental_disclosures.remaining_work: M8-05 wraps in tokio::task::spawn_blocking if real shrink loops prove expensive.

experimental_disclosures.title: counterexample_list pagination (next_cursor)
experimental_disclosures.m8_03_status: STUB — next_cursor: None always. Field is on the wire DTO so the addition is shape-preserving.
experimental_disclosures.remaining_work: M8-05 fills in proper cursor encoding.

experimental_disclosures.title: Bundle-as-blob storage inefficiency
experimental_disclosures.m8_03_status: ACCEPTED. Single redb blob per bundle (events included). Cost: full rewrite per save.
experimental_disclosures.remaining_work: M8-04 splits events into a side table when engine.get_all_events() is plumbed.

experimental_disclosures.m8_03_status: ACCEPTED. Minimised payload DTOs carry PropertyValue / ExistencePredicate / (caller, callee, max_depth) but never raw trace.
experimental_disclosures.remaining_work: M8-05 adds counterexample_bundle_events tool if acceptance demands the full payload on the wire.
